This fourth application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR/Crime No.1010/2022 registered at Police Station Kolgawan, District Satna, for the offence under Sections 304(B), 498A, 34 and later on added 302 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

The applicant is in jail since 30.09.2022.

He submits that even the doctor i.e. PW-7 namely Jaspal Meena was examined and as per her statement also, it does not reveal that the deceased was given poison because in the post-mortem report, the presence of zinc phosphate was not noticed by the doctor, therefore, she did not mention it.

He submits that there is every possibility of manipulation in viscera and as such,
in the viscera zinc phosphate was noticed.

He submits that even otherwise, looking to the period of custody i.e. w.e.f. 30.09.2022 and the stage of trial when all material witnesses have been examined,
bail application can be considered and allowed.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.

5. Considering the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, perusal of material available on record, especially the statement of the witnesses, I am inclined to consider and allow this bail application.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
7. On being released on bail, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE ac/-
